ella: Heads-up - HelioWare wants a joint co-sell POC. Needs: completed SecQ, pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted, joint deployment diagram, and demo the week of Aug 5. Can we divvy up tasks?

ravi: I can own the SecQ and cert bundle. Need partner data classification + confirmation on PII. Will request InfoSec fast-track.

tess: I'll sketch the architecture and canary plan. Quick Q: prefer proposing VPC peering first, then private appliance as fallback?

ella: yes, start with peering + dedicated pool in eu-west-1, call out private deployment if residency/legal block. Also need canary rollout steps.

ravi: SecQ priority items: EU residency, KMS CMK support, log retention & redaction, SOC2/ISO proof. I'll add a DLP attestation checkbox for partner to sign.

infra-bot: Peering checklist: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/partner-peering (internal) :link:

tess: draft arch bullets:
```
- HelioWare app in partner VPC (eu-west-1)
- VPC peering -> Redwood Private control plane + Dedicated GPU pool
- Auth: SAML SSO + SCIM; exchange metadata
- KMS: customer-managed key required for persisted artifacts
- Network: egress-only, strict ACLs; monitoring + alerting on anomalies
- Rollout: 5% canary route -> monitor latency & errors -> ramp
```

ella: Pricing ask: Ravi or Tess can you produce a quick ballpark for committed monthly (150 QPS steady) vs hosted per-token? Flag private appliance as much higher.

tess: I can run a quick estimate by EOD. I'll include impact of int4 quant and batching.

ravi: SecQ draft ETA Mon 09:00 UTC if InfoSec approves. I'll request the partner attestation about no PII in telemetry.

ella: Action items: ravi = SecQ + certs + DLP attestation, tess = arch + canary runbook + pricing note, ella = partner comms & legal loop. Demo window dependent on partner confirmation. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
